name: ExcelApplication
label: Excel Application
description: The Excel Application object containing the target worksheet.

name: ActiveCellAddress
label: Active Cell Address
description: Returns the address of the active cell (e.g., 'A1').

name: ActiveCellColumnIndex
label: Active Cell Column Index
description: Returns the column index of the active cell.

name: ActiveCellRowIndex
label: Active Cell Row Index
description: Returns the row index of the active cell.
